stem: How do the raindrops in the story “Do What You Can” DIFFER from the sons in the story “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi”?
instruction: Use “Do What You Can” and “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: The raindrops do not have different abilities, but the sons do.

options.label: G
options.text: The raindrops do not listen to one another, but the sons do.

options.label: H
options.text: The raindrops do not spend time together, but the sons do.

options.label: J
options.text: The raindrops do not like one another, but the sons do.
